title: The server image's first GPU start: built from main on a GPU virtual machine, started with the compose file, example request and conformance C2-C4 answered, restarted from the cached volume (launch checklist gate 3.0)
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition (97,887 MiB), a KVM virtual machine on vast.ai with the card passed through, 19 vCPUs, 98 GB RAM, 146 GB disk

software.image: decisio:local, built on the machine from the Dockerfile at the commit below (not pushed); image ID sha256:3502ca48d21c368f9ffaf2d2f003683cd1fddba418a1c500d7d3dfd725e7cd87
software.base_image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0@sha256:8a69ffad015f138d7170c4ddc429e230a3bc1c1719f67e14324749df200a4b90 (FROM line of the Dockerfile; vLLM 0.30.0, build commit ced6857)
software.checkpoint: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 at revision 95a723d08a9490559dae23d0cff1d9466213d989 (snapshot directory name); weight files and their blob sha256 names in checkpoint_files.txt
software.docker: Docker Engine 29.0.3, NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.18.0 (nvidia runtime), Compose v2.40.3
software.python_for_the_wheel_build: uv 0.9.11 with a managed CPython 3.12.12 (the VM has 3.10)

code.note: main at the time; compose.yaml and Dockerfile as at that commit

servers.command: docker compose up -d (compose.yaml: build context ., volume decisio-data at /data, GPU reservation, 127.0.0.1:8000:8000); the entry point's served-default flags; no extra arguments

gates.healthy: pass: health check healthy, failing streak 0 (compose_ps.json, health.json)
gates.example_request: pass: HTTP 200, answers urgent (noul), category (choice, access), impact (score) in the documented shapes (example_response.json)
gates.C3: pass: 200 of 200 items give the same prompt in both routes
gates.C4: pass: 200 items, max_abs_delta_p exactly 0.0, no top-answer flips, temperature 1.307
gates.second_start: pass: healthy from the cached volume; the example request returns the same chosen options and probabilities, difference 0.0 (example_response_second_start.json)

results.first_start_includes: the 36 GB checkpoint download (about 121 MB/s), model loading 338 s in all, CUDA graph capture 144 s and 75 s (server_first_start.log)

inputs.items_file: conformance_items.json, 200 items (100 BoolQ validation, 100 BANKING77 test), made by benchmarks/make_conformance_items.py (pull request #18); sha256 of the file and of the generator in items_and_generator.sha256; sha256 of the two downloads in items_source.txt. The file holds benchmark item text and is not part of this record.
inputs.example_request: the request printed in README.md, extracted by script (example_request.json)

deviations: The VM has Python 3.10 only; uv installed CPython 3.12.12 for the wheel build (vm_setup_notes.txt).

The conformance client ran in a second container of the same image on the host network, with typesafe-sdk 0.7.0 added, not from a host environment made with uv sync --extra bench: the VM reached PyPI at about 0.7 MB/s and the CUDA wheels of torch would have taken over an hour (vm_setup_notes.txt, pip_typesafe.log).

The wheel and the image were built on the machine, so the image has an ID and no registry digest; the digest on ghcr.io is a different build and is checked once after the first release (checklist 3.0, step 11).
excluded: the conformance rows keep ids, labels and probabilities, no text
